usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance-fast/t2v with JSON body {prompt} (x402 USDC on Base; optional duration, aspectRatio, outputResolution). Returns {jobId, status:"pending"}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX (free) until status=complete.
usage.outputShape: Generate call: body.jobId, body.status. Poll call (GET /api/jobs/{jobId}): body.status (pending|loading|complete), body.progress, and on completion body.result.videoUrl + body.result.thumbnailUrl.
quirks: ASYNC: the paid POST returns {success, jobId, status:'pending', type} immediately — NOT the video. You MUST poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} to get the result.
POLL AUTH IS SIWX, NOT PAYMENT: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} requires a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header (free, no USDC). Same wallet that paid. qa-pay --siwx handles it.

Body {prompt} alone works; service auto-applies defaults duration='5', aspectRatio='16:9', outputResolution='720p'. Optional fields: duration, aspectRatio, outputResolution (480p/720p), resolution, upscaleResolution:'4k' (much pricier), callBackUrl.
DYNAMIC PRICING: priced ~$0.08-$0.17/sec; a 5s 720p clip cost $0.84. Cap is $20 per spec so guard your ceiling.
RESULT URLs EXPIRE in ~20 minutes — download videoUrl/thumbnailUrl immediately after completion.
Video generation takes 1-3min; poll every ~15-20s. progress goes 10 -> 95 -> 100/complete.
Do NOT resubmit while status is pending/loading — duplicate submits create duplicate PAID jobs. Keep polling the original jobId.
URL NOTE: prior existingUsage referenced different backends (x402.ottoai.services, blockrun.ai); the canonical, verified endpoint is stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance-fast/t2v.
usage.guide: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/seedance-fast/t2v with JSON {"prompt":"..."} and pay via x402 USDC on Base (dynamic, ~$0.08-0.17/sec; a 5s 720p clip = $0.84). The response is an async job {jobId, status:"pending"}, not the video. Poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header (free, same wallet) every ~15-20s until status=="complete", then read the video at body.result.videoUrl (and body.result.thumbnailUrl). Download the asset immediately — the URLs expire in about 20 minutes. Never resubmit while a job is pending/loading; duplicate POSTs create duplicate paid jobs.
